item.title: Morocco Plans Digital Overhaul of Its Islamic Notary System
item.description: Morocco’s Economic, Social and Environmental Council wants blockchain security, AI tools, and gender-parity rules built into a rewrite of the law governing the country’s roughly 3,100 Adouls — the traditional notaries who certify marriage, divorce, inheritance, and will documents that Moroccans abroad frequently need.
